text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
âAnd she makes her presence known in magnificent fashion!
Dantsu Flame!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I gave it everything I had...! Thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(I just have to keep going—keep doing my best like this.
If I do, I'm sure—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (I want to be a "protagonist" too, just like everyone else!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I intend to keep following this path, chasing the dream of becoming the "protagonist" that I've always longed for.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'll keep working hard step by step so I can become an Umamusume who leaves a lasting impression on everyone—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I'll be in your care!
Please keep supporting Dantsu Flame!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame, who showed solid capability
in the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her ability, and above all her earnest dedication,
seemed to gradually start winning people over—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
There are comments...
We've gotten a few comments on UmaStagram.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"The Mile Championship was wonderful.
I'm rooting for your hard work, Dantsu!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"‘You're always so positive.
It gives me energy. I'm cheering for you!’"
choice_data_list: Looks like we're starting to gain more fans.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: A fan—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...
I-I see...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the next day,
Dantsu Flame came to me with a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: How about making the Takarazuka Kinen our target race for the Senior Class?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen is
a late-June race to decide the Medium distance champion. It's characterized by runners earning the right to compete through fan voting."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Well, it is the royal road's grand spring Grand Prix, so there's that, of course."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um... isn't that the fan vote?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If you want to be the main star,
I believe you have to be the kind of presence chosen for the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Captivating the hearts of many and drawing their cheers.
I believe a girl who can do that is the true lead.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And so, if I'm chosen for the Takarazuka Kinen
and manage to win it, I'm sure that will be
right in the center of the spotlight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Chosen by the fans, and delivering them a victory. That stage really is the perfect place to be the star."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"A-And also! The Takarazuka Kinen is at the end of June,
right? I want to gain more race experience
and grow even more by then...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I know I still have a long way to go, but I want to grow so I can go out with a bang at the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a necessary stepping stone
toward the grand stage we will eventually reach—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A Senior-class GIII middle-distance race held in Niigata.
If I recall correctly, Mejiro Palmer, a Takarazuka Kinen winner,
also claimed victory here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The long final stretch easily turns into a fierce contest
for position. If you can hold your own there, it should also
serve you well in a heated battle to the finish at the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wah, Niigata sounds wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I need to polish my running so everyone over there
will remember who I am, too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Steadily, one step at a time. First, the Niigata Daishoten.
I want to win that and carry the momentum into the Takarazuka Kinen!
